question: By what means should the initial sixteen-wheel group be suspended?
premises: Suspension is prescribed as an action.
The root mantra serves as the instrument.
The initial sixteen-wheel group is the object.
inference: The initial sixteen-wheel group should be suspended by means of the root mantra.
uncertainties: The precise ritual sense of suspension is not fully specified.
plain_english: And one should suspend the initial sixteen-wheel group by means of the root mantra.
